mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.friend AS userId, f.is_read AS isRead, f.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS friendName FROM friend f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON f.friend = u.id WHERE f.myself = #{myself} AND f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT m.id, m.myself AS senderId,
IF(m.myself = #{myId}, m.friend, m.myself) AS userId,
u.username AS friendName, m.content, m.is_read AS isRead,
m.create_time AS updateTime FROM Friend m
LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = IF(m.myself = #{myId}, m.friend, m.myself) WHERE (m.myself = #{myId} AND m.friend = #{userId}) OR (m.myself = #{userId} AND m.friend = #{myId}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Friend ( myself, friend, content, is_read, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{myself}, #{friend}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
